title.title: Title
title.description: Names the viewer collection and the MultiQC report.

data_types.title: Data types
data_types.description: Data types to look for. Select none to look for every type in the catalog.

recurse.title: Recurse into subfolders
recurse.description: Walk into subfolders looking for datasets. A folder recognized as a dataset is not descended into. Off means each input dataset is itself expected to be a single spatial dataset.

preprocess.title: Run preprocessing recipes
preprocess.description: Run each data type's preprocessing recipes after loading. Off loads and publishes the data unanalyzed.

min_reads_per_cell.title: Min reads per cell
min_reads_per_cell.description: Drop cells/spots with fewer than this many total transcripts. (Xenium, MERSCOPE, CosMx, Visium, Visium HD, Curio Seeker)

max_reads_per_cell.title: Max reads per cell
max_reads_per_cell.description: Drop spots with more than this many total counts (doublet/artefact ceiling); whole-transcriptome recipes only. (Visium, Visium HD, Curio Seeker)

min_cells_per_gene.title: Min cells per gene
min_cells_per_gene.description: Drop genes detected in fewer than this many cells. (Xenium, MERSCOPE, CosMx)

n_top_genes.title: Highly variable genes
n_top_genes.description: Highly variable genes kept for PCA; whole-transcriptome data only. (Visium, Visium HD, Curio Seeker)

cluster_key.title: Cluster key
cluster_key.description: obs column the clustering writes, and the labels the neighborhood analysis groups by. (all types)

resolution.title: Leiden resolution
resolution.description: Leiden resolution; higher gives more, smaller clusters. (Xenium, MERSCOPE, CosMx, Steinbock, MCMICRO)

marker_method.title: Marker-gene test
marker_method.description: Differential-expression test used to rank marker genes per cluster. (Xenium, MERSCOPE, CosMx, Visium, Visium HD, Curio Seeker)

n_marker_genes.title: Marker genes per cluster
n_marker_genes.description: Top marker genes per cluster shown in the marker dotplot. (Xenium, MERSCOPE, CosMx)

neighborhood_resolution.title: Neighborhood resolution
neighborhood_resolution.description: Leiden resolution for cellular neighborhoods; higher gives more, smaller niches. (all types)

neighborhood_key.title: Neighborhood key
neighborhood_key.description: obs column the neighborhood labels are written to. (all types)

lowres_max_image_mb.title: Low-res image budget (MB)
lowres_max_image_mb.description: Image budget for the low-resolution copy written beside every checkpoint; the finest pyramid levels are dropped until the images fit.
